title: docs(spec): the security-service contract describes an empty optional controlled_by_parent master reference
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiPNRknnohwjfU4LkaBEoT56)_

Fixes #31094

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：只改 `packages/spec` 里安全服务契约的注释（JSDoc）：`master_chain` 拒绝、`master_reference_missing` 原因、`allow` 结果和 `checkControlledByParentWrite` 自身说明，现在都写明「可选主表为空」的行按属主规则判：属主或该对象「修改全部」可写，其他人在 `master_chain` 上被拒；链上某一跳的可选主表为空时，链在那一跳按同一规则结束。必填主表为空仍是原来的答案。
- **为什么改**：您对 #30905 的裁决「A」已由 PR #31082 落到写门，但契约注释还写着「主表一定必填」「写子记录一定要主记录编辑权」，读契约的人会得出错误结论。
- **风险与回滚**：纯注释加一个 patch changeset，类型、导出、运行时行为都不变；回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts` 里 `ControlledByParentWriteDenialLeg` 的 `master_chain` 一条。
- **两分钟验证**：`git diff origin/main -- packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`，预期只有注释行变化。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

JSDoc only, in `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`, plus an `'@objectstack/spec': patch` changeset. Each sentence was checked against the write gate (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts`) and PR #31082's tests (`controlled-by-parent-optional-master.test.ts`), under ADR-0055 §3 as amended 2026-11-07 (maintainer ruling 「A」 on #30905 / #30906):

1. `ControlledByParentWriteDenialLeg`: the intro and `master_chain` now cover the record whose own optional master reference is empty (refused to a principal who neither owns it nor holds Modify All on its object; a row with no owner, or of an object without `owner_id`, is Modify All's alone), and a master above whose optional master is empty (the three legs run on it, then that row's owner rule ends the chain). Only a required master's empty reference above the record is the chain-walk refusal the old text described.
2. `ControlledByParentWriteUnresolvedReason`: `master_reference_missing` is a stored **required** master reference left empty; an empty optional one answers `allow` or `deny` on `master_chain`.
3. `ISecurityService.checkControlledByParentWrite`: "requires EDIT access to its master, or, where its optional master reference is empty, ownership of the record or Modify All on its object".

Beyond the card's three items, the same file's sentences that the ruling also made false were corrected in place (same defect class, same file): the `allow` bullet of `ControlledByParentWriteOutcome`, the "answers the master check alone" sentence, and the empty-permission-set bullet (such a principal answers on `master_chain`, never `object_permission`, for a record whose optional master is empty). The ⛔ lines at the end of the member's docblock are untouched.

## Tests

No behaviour change, so no test is added. The behaviour the text describes is pinned by `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/controlled-by-parent-optional-master.test.ts` (`ISecurityService.checkControlledByParentWrite answers as the write path does`, including the required-master `master_reference_missing` control).

## Acceptance notes

- No generated reference embeds this JSDoc: `content/docs/references/**` has no hit for these names, and `api-surface/contracts.json` / `export-origins/contracts.json` list the type names only, so nothing is regenerated.
- Noted, not fixed here (pre-existing): the `allow` bullet does not mention the `sharing.controlledByParent.ownerMayEdit` opt-in leg (ADR-0055 §3 amendment of 2026-10-26), through which a by-id update by the row's owner with READ on the master also resolves `allow`. Handed to the seat for a separate card.
- An independent full review of the diff found one should-fix and two nits, all applied; the delta review passed. Its verdict is posted as a comment on this PR.

## Verification

Local gates on the final head are listed in the card's `os-dev-report`; CI runs the full set.
